steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: You need to be able to convert between all three number bases: decimal (base 10), binary (base 2), and hexadecimal (base 16). There are six possible conversions to master. | Method: Write out the binary place values above each bit. Add up all the place values where there is a 1. Ignore positions with a 0. | Method: Repeatedly divide the decimal number by 2. Record the remainder each time (it will always be 0 or 1). Read the remainders from bottom to top to get the binary number. | Method: Find the largest power of 2 that fits into the number. Subtract it and put a 1 in that position. Repeat with the remainder. Put 0s in positions where the power doesn't fit.
